name: The atom and the model of the atom

terms.definition: About 1 × 10⁻¹⁰ m in radius; the nucleus is less than 1/10 000 of that.
terms.examiner: Most of the mass is in the nucleus.

terms.definition: Atoms of an element with the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
terms.examiner: Same atomic number, different mass number.

terms.definition: An atom that has lost (or gained) outer electrons and so has a charge.
terms.examiner: Electrons move to a higher level if they absorb radiation.

terms.definition: Most alpha particles passed straight through the gold foil but a few were deflected, showing the mass and positive charge are concentrated in a tiny nucleus.
terms.examiner: This replaced the plum pudding model.

terms.definition: Electrons orbit the nucleus at specific distances (energy levels).
terms.examiner: Chadwick later showed the neutron exists.
